## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
DBH_protein <- DBH_olink_irn %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_pheno, by="FINNGENID") %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(PC1:PC10))
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
plot(DBH_irn ~ allele, data=DBH_protein)
```

```{r}
DBH_protein$allele <- factor(DBH_protein$allele, levels = c("REFERENCE", "HETEROZYGOUS", "HOMOZYGOUS"))

p<- ggplot(DBH_protein, aes(x = allele, y = DBH_irn)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.1, fill = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "DBH protein expression level (IRN)"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16)
  )

ggsave(filename = "olink_violin.pdf",
       plot = p, 
       width = 10,
       height = 8,
       units = "in")
```
